mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 37 degrees and overcast at Verona Community Park. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

For our city news, candidates for the four City of Verona Aldermanic Districts on the 2027 spring ballot must file their nomination papers and declarations of candidacy at City Hall by 5 PM on January 5. Additionally, residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and payments can be made online, by mail, or via the secure drop box at the City Center.

There is plenty to do in town. Today you can find Yoga at Insight Wellness or check out ART House 360, while tomorrow features trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company and live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In the latest report covering November 1 through November 15, Verona police were kept busy responding to various calls, including domestic disturbances and an O W I arrest.
The Culver's restaurant is closed today, but you can look forward to the return of Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day when the doors open tomorrow at 10 AM.
